# Elementary Data | Data Observability for AI and Analytics

> The only data observability solution integrated into your dbt pipelines. Monitor data pipelines in minutes, directly from your dbt project. Now with AI agents that write tests, analyze root cause, generate metadata, and improve query performance automatically. Elementary is built for and trusted by 5,000+ analytics and data engineers.
> 

For inquiries: [contactus@elementary-data.com](mailto:contactus@elementary-data.com)

## Products

Elementary includes two products:

### Elementary OSS

Elementary OSS is a CLI tool that works alongside the [Elementary dbt package](https://docs.elementary-data.com/data-tests/dbt/dbt-package). With the dbt package, you gain powerful anomaly detection tests and metadata tables to monitor data quality trends over time.

Elementary OSS is best for data and analytics engineers that require basic observability capabilities or for evaluating features without vendor approval. Our community can provide great support if needed.

### Elementary Cloud Platform

The Elementary Cloud Platform integrates into dbt workflows, providing a developer-centric tool for engineers to maintain and govern data quality rules while also offering a cloud-based interface for business users and data stewards.

The solution is secure by design, and requires no access to your data from cloud.

The cloud platform is built on top of the OSS package, ideal for teams monitoring mission-critical data pipelines, requiring guaranteed uptime and reliability, short-time-to-value, advanced features, collaboration, and professional support.

The cloud platform has the following features:

- [AI Agents](https://www.elementary-data.com/ai-agents): Overview of how AI agents automate test creation, incident triage, governance, discovery, and performance optimization.
- [Detection & Coverage](https://www.elementary-data.com/detection-and-coverage): Information on comprehensive data tests and ML-powered monitors that provide better coverage for data observability.
- [Governance](https://www.elementary-data.com/governance-and-discovery): A unified interface for analysts and engineers to explore data and manage metadata efficiently.
- [Triage and Response](https://www.elementary-data.com/triage-and-resolution): Tools and strategies to understand, prioritize, and resolve data issues more quickly.
- [Enabling business users](https://www.elementary-data.com/business-users): Tools designed for analysts and business users to explore data, add validations, and monitor data health.
